summary:
Dedicated Full Stack Engineer specializing in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js). Proven track
record of translating business requirements into clean, efficient code and user-friendly interfaces. Demonstrated
expertise in RESTful API integration, state management, and delivering high-quality software solutions using modern
web standards.

bullets: 1). Khiladi India (Multi-Vendor Sports Ecosystem Platform) Role: Full-Stack Developer – Responsible for complete frontend UI architecture (React.js), backend REST API development (Node.js/Express.js), and database schema design (MongoDB). Key features include:

Multi-Category Marketplace Architecture: Developed a dynamic platform supporting diverse business categories including Sports Shops, Academies, Schools, Coaches, and Event Organizers, allowing distinct data structures for each entity.

Comprehensive Vendor Dashboard: Built a robust dashboard where vendors can manage their specific profiles—shops can manage inventory, academies can schedule classes, and trainers can update availability—in real-time.
Recruitment & Job Portal Module: Implemented a dedicated job section enabling vendors to post vacancies (e.g., for coaches or staff) and review applicant profiles directly through the platform.
Dynamic Content Rendering: Designed a flexible React frontend that adapts the UI layout based on the category selected (e.g., displaying product grids for Shops vs. course lists for Academies).
Search & Filtering Logic: Created advanced filtering APIs allowing users to search for specific equipment, locate nearby academies, or find trainers based on sport type and location.

bullets: 1). Ebox Cinema (Online Movie Booking Platform) Role: Full-Stack Developer – Responsible for frontend UI development (React.js), backend REST API architecture (Node.js/Express.js), and database modeling (MongoDB) Key features include:
Developed End-to-End Booking Flow: Built a seamless movie ticket booking system allowing users to select movies, view showtimes, and book tickets with real-time seat availability.

Admin Dashboard for Theatre Management: Created a comprehensive admin panel to manage movie listings, show timings, theater screens, and pricing rules using React forms and Redux.
